name: 毛绒猫咪头盔套
description:
猫耳毛绒头盔套，圆脸颊，张着嘴的表情。四个颜色各一件，可以选：绿色（薄荷绿）、蓝色（天蓝）、黄色（奶黄）、粉色。

第一张是四色合集，选了颜色会换成那一色的单品图。
descriptionEn:
Plush cat-ear helmet cover with round cheeks and an open-mouth smile. One of each in four colors: green (mint), blue (sky blue), yellow (cream) and pink.

The first photo shows all four colors — pick a color to see that one on its own.

name: 黑猫头盔套
description: 黑猫毛绒头盔套，圆圆的大眼睛，粉色内耳和脸颊。
descriptionEn: Plush black cat helmet cover with big round eyes and pink inner ears and cheeks.

name: Hello Kitty 头盔套
description: 白色毛绒头盔套，粉色蝴蝶结和粉色包边，黄色鼻子。
descriptionEn: White plush helmet cover with a pink bow, pink trim and a yellow nose.

name: 库洛米头盔套
description: 黑白毛绒头盔套，头顶两个黑球，紫色蝴蝶结，额头一颗粉色骷髅。
descriptionEn: Black-and-white plush helmet cover with two black pom-poms on top, a purple bow and a pink skull on the forehead.

name: 小猪头盔套
description: 粉色毛绒头盔套，猪耳、猪鼻，脑后有一圈卷卷的小尾巴。
descriptionEn: Pink plush helmet cover with piggy ears, a snout and a curly little tail at the back.

name: 黑粉兔耳头盔套
description: 黑色卷卷毛绒头盔套，一对玫红色内里的兔耳朵，头顶一颗玫红小毛球，又酷又可爱。
descriptionEn: Curly black plush helmet cover with hot-pink-lined bunny ears and a hot-pink pom-pom on top — cool and cute at the same time.

name: 白色垂耳兔头盔套
description: 白色卷卷毛绒头盔套，两只粉色内里的长垂耳，头顶粉色蝴蝶结，粉色刺绣眼睛。
descriptionEn: Curly white plush helmet cover with long pink-lined floppy ears, pink bows on top and pink embroidered eyes.

name: 白色小羊头盔套
description: 白色卷卷毛绒头盔套，头顶一对浅蓝色小羊角，粉色内耳，侧边一颗黄色小星星，粉蓝刺绣眼睛。
descriptionEn: Curly white plush helmet cover with two little light-blue sheep horns, pink inner ears, a yellow star on the side and pink-and-blue embroidered eyes.

name: 三花猫头盔套
description: 白色卷卷毛绒头盔套，奶黄色和棕色的三花斑块，粉色内耳，耳边一朵小雏菊，一蓝一黄的鸳鸯眼。
descriptionEn: Curly white plush helmet cover with cream and brown calico patches, pink inner ears, a little daisy by the ear and odd eyes — one blue, one yellow.

name: 奶黄小羊头盔套
description: 奶黄色卷卷毛绒头盔套，头顶两只黄色小羊角，粉色内耳和腮红，两侧垂着小毛球。
descriptionEn: Curly cream-yellow plush helmet cover with two little yellow sheep horns, pink inner ears and cheeks, and pom-poms hanging at the sides.

name: 暹罗猫头盔套
description: 白色卷卷毛绒头盔套，暹罗猫配色的奶茶色耳朵和脸，画着小胡须，耳边别着一条浅蓝色小鱼。
descriptionEn: Curly white plush helmet cover in Siamese-cat colors — latte-brown ears and face, little whiskers, and a light-blue fish clipped by the ear.

name: 黑猫月亮头盔套
description: 黑色卷卷毛绒头盔套，粉色猫耳，额头一枚黄色弯月亮，黄色眼睛配粉色腮红。
descriptionEn: Curly black plush helmet cover with pink cat ears, a yellow crescent moon on the forehead, yellow eyes and pink cheeks.
